schema_ddl:
CREATE DOMAIN importo_stipendio AS NUMERIC(10,2) CHECK (VALUE >= 500 AND VALUE <= 50000);

CREATE DOMAIN livello_seniorita AS TEXT CHECK (VALUE IN ('junior', 'mid', 'senior'));

CREATE TABLE dipartimenti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    nome_dipartimento TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    sede TEXT NOT NULL,
    budget_annuo NUMERIC(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (budget_annuo > 0),
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE dipendenti (
    id INT PRIMARY KEY,
    dipartimento_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES dipartimenti(id),
    nome TEXT NOT NULL,
    cognome TEXT NOT NULL,
    codice_fiscale TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email TEXT UNIQUE,
    data_assunzione DATE NOT NULL,
    stipendio_mensile importo_stipendio NOT NULL,
    seniority livello_seniorita NOT NULL DEFAULT 'junior',
    attivo BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
